census.method: raw E8/E9 scan over .text file offsets 0x1418300..0x63efa00, every E8 site rel32-verified to 0x63a8ff0; RIP-relative LEA scan over .text; .rela.dyn (60,723 entries) and .rela.plt (278 entries) addend scans; FDE grouping via .eh_frame

dispatcher_caller_fdes.note: five large stats-reader/dumper FDEs holding the 54 dispatcher call sites; surveyed for counts and FDE grouping, not decoded in depth and not claimed

dispatcher_helper.note: fixed call at 0x63a9287 to 0x636e340 inside the dispatcher, before the handler tail-call; purpose not decoded, cited only

dispatcher_init.note: one-time init function called when .bss flag 0x6712140 is clear; cited only

name_strings.note: .rodata name pointers decoded for the tree diagram only: '' at 0x4376fd, 'stats' at 0x44869a, 'mutexes' at 0x4385fa, 'reset' at 0x440c22, plus sibling names; cited only, not claimed

packet_251_helper.note: the wait helper itself; cited for record-layout context only

packet_253_sweep.note: the reset sweep FDE; it is the reset leaf's handler, cited by address only, never re-claimed

packet_254_recordreset.note: the record-reset work function the sweep calls at its 18 sites; cited only

sibling_nodes.note: all root/stats/mutexes children other than the four path nodes; names, kinds and child counts verified by scan for the tree diagram, cited only, not claimed

dispatcher.walk: index array in %rsi, count in %rdx; per level: index bounds-checked against node+0x10 count, child = children_array + index*40, descend via child+0x18 children pointer; flag-0 nodes resolve through the function at +0x08; on completion the leaf's +0x20 handler is tail-called with the caller's original arguments

dispatcher.shows: index-walking control dispatcher: root children LEA, root node LEA, per-level bounds check and child step, dynamic-node calls, leaf handler null check, handler load and tail-call

node_mutexes.shows: interior node [1, 'mutexes', 10, 0x64dac60, 0]; the reset leaf is its child index 9

node_reset.shows: leaf node [1, 'reset', 0, 0, 0x63a5bf0]; the sweep FDE is its +0x20 handler

node_root.shows: root node [1, '', 13, 0x64da500, 0]; 'stats' is its child index 11

node_stats.shows: interior node [1, 'stats', 11, 0x64daaa0, 0]; 'mutexes' is its child index 8
